title: Symthaea finite-state EVSI input with separate costs and downside-risk gate
description: Structural schema for the offline research-taste reference calculator. Cross-array dimensional equalities and probability-mass constraints are enforced by the Rust semantic validator.

prior.description: Must have the same length as states and sum to one.

utilities.description: One row per action and one column per state.

likelihood_by_state.description: One value per state; outcome likelihoods must sum to one across outcomes for each state.

direct_experiment_cost.description: Direct resource cost converted into the preregistered utility unit.

opportunity_cost.description: Value of the best foregone alternative use, net of direct experiment cost and in the same utility unit.

downside_loss_by_outcome.description: Non-negative modeled downside loss for each outcome, in the same utility unit and in the same order as outcomes.

cvar_confidence.description: Confidence level for upper-tail CVaR; 0.95 evaluates the worst 5% of predictive downside-loss mass.

max_cvar_downside_loss.description: Maximum admissible CVaR loss; checked independently from positive net EVSI.
